pattern: Native buttons inside an element with role=group and an accessible name (WAI-ARIA group role). Not the APG Toolbar pattern.

keyboard.action: Moves through every enabled button in DOM order (native).

focus: Each button shows its own :focus-visible outline. In attached groups the focused button is raised and the ring is inset so the scroll container does not clip it.
notes: aria-orientation is not set: the group role does not support it and there is no arrow-key navigation.
For a toolbar with arrow-key roving focus, a Toolbar component is planned.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
